## Summary

The nuclei project's historical security posture is dominated by sandbox escape risks in the Tengo workflow engine, where two separate fixes progressively tightened the module import allowlist to prevent arbitrary code execution and network access. A second recurring theme is insecure file permissions: multiple write paths (debug output, template installation) created files with world-writable 0777 modes, which were hardened to 0644/0755. A single path traversal (zip-slip) in template extraction was also fixed via canonicalization and prefix validation. The most critical residual risk is that the sandbox module allowlist is enforced only in the workflow processor, while other script execution paths (e.g., headless browser) may not apply the same restrictions. File permission issues are scattered across components, indicating a systemic lack of a centralized safe-write helper.

## Top Risks

### 1. Sandbox Escape: `v2/internal/runner/processor.go` (high)

Tengo workflow scripts could import arbitrary stdlib modules, enabling code execution and network access. Two fixes progressively restricted the module map, but the guard is only on this processor path.

Evidence: cf2a98b03d76327c20fb0183b7f1c849eb692c91, 96049a32fa70aef0483d4180d386a57b3c2d973a

### 2. Sandbox Escape: `v2/pkg/protocols/headless/engine/engine.go` (high)

Chrome headless was launched with --no-sandbox unconditionally, allowing sandbox escape. Fix restricted it to Linux root only, but other browser launch paths may still disable sandbox.

Evidence: df55f7a2eb591a7949b5c66a9c54db54aa28f450

### 3. Insecure File Permissions: `v2/pkg/output/output.go` (medium)

Debug data files created with 0777 permissions, exposing sensitive data. Fixed to 0644, but other output paths may still use permissive modes.

Evidence: af4854f90de728bb08689d5cae3dec4acfdb6b9a

### 4. Insecure File Permissions: `Multiple (files, cmd, internal, pkg)` (medium)

Template files and directories written with 0777/0755 modes across multiple components, risking unauthorized modification. Hardened to 0644/0755, but the pattern may recur in new write paths.

Evidence: 4bccb6cf8a830724b3bda624cb3bfe43eff31683

### 5. Path Traversal: `v2/internal/runner/update.go` (high)

Template extraction allowed zip-slip, writing files outside the target directory. Fixed with canonicalization and prefix check, but other extraction or file-writing paths may lack this validation.

Evidence: f9c214a66f37a00fc29fe64232b690e6285ec59c

## Shared Attack Surfaces

Capabilities guarded by more than one past fix on different code paths. A guard enforced on one entry point is often missing on a sibling; verify each alternate path before assuming it's covered.

### 1. Script module import allowlist for workflow execution

- Guard that should hold everywhere: sandbox flag enabled AND SetImports restricted to safe subset (stdlib.GetModuleMap with allowlisted modules)
- Entry points: `v2/internal/runner/processor.go (workflow processor)`, `v2/pkg/protocols/headless/engine/engine.go (headless browser script execution)`, `any other Tengo script execution path (e.g., templates with script blocks)`
- Check: Verify that all script execution paths (not just the workflow processor) enforce the same module allowlist; the headless engine or template script blocks may import dangerous modules without the sandbox flag.
- Evidence: cf2a98b03d76327c20fb0183b7f1c849eb692c91, 96049a32fa70aef0483d4180d386a57b3c2d973a

### 2. File creation with restrictive permissions

- Guard that should hold everywhere: os.OpenFile/ioutil.WriteFile with mode 0644 (files) and os.MkdirAll with 0755 (dirs); never os.ModePerm
- Entry points: `v2/pkg/output/output.go (debug output)`, `Multiple components: files, cmd, internal, pkg (template installation, config writes)`, `v2/internal/runner/update.go (template extraction)`
- Check: Audit every os.OpenFile/ioutil.WriteFile/os.MkdirAll call site for hardcoded 0777 or os.ModePerm; new write paths (e.g., cache, report generation) may still use permissive modes.
- Evidence: af4854f90de728bb08689d5cae3dec4acfdb6b9a, 4bccb6cf8a830724b3bda624cb3bfe43eff31683

## Fixed-Issue Fingerprints

These are real security fixes mined from git history. Use them as regression checks.

- **Insecure File Permissions** (medium) [CWE-276]: Changes file creation permissions from 0777 to 0644, preventing unauthorized read/write access to debug data files.
  - sink: `os.OpenFile(filename, os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE, os.ModePerm)`
  - fix: Restrict file permissions to 0644
  - commit: https://github.com/unashamedgeek/nuclei/commit/af4854f90de728bb08689d5cae3dec4acfdb6b9a (2022-06-20)
- **Sandbox Escape** (high) [CWE-250]: Restricts the --no-sandbox flag to only when running as root on Linux, preventing sandbox escape on other configurations.
  - sink: `chromeLauncher.NoSandbox(true)`
  - fix: Restrict sandbox disabling to Linux root user
  - commit: https://github.com/unashamedgeek/nuclei/commit/df55f7a2eb591a7949b5c66a9c54db54aa28f450 (2021-12-05)
- **Path Traversal** (high) [CWE-22]: Fixes zip-slip path traversal in template extraction by validating the destination path.
  - sink: `os.OpenFile`
  - fix: path canonicalization and prefix check
  - commit: https://github.com/unashamedgeek/nuclei/commit/f9c214a66f37a00fc29fe64232b690e6285ec59c (2021-11-25)
- **Insecure File Permissions** (medium) [CWE-276]: Tightens file and directory permissions from 0777/0755 to 0644/0755, reducing the risk of unauthorized modification or disclosure.
  - sink: `ioutil.WriteFile(filePath, []byte(newTemplate), 0777)`
  - fix: Restrict file and directory permissions to 0644/0755
  - commit: https://github.com/unashamedgeek/nuclei/commit/4bccb6cf8a830724b3bda624cb3bfe43eff31683 (2021-11-24)
- **Sandbox Escape** (high) [CWE-250]: Adds a sandbox flag that limits workflow modules to a safe subset, preventing arbitrary code execution.
  - sink: `script.SetImports(stdlib.GetModuleMap(stdlib.AllModuleNames()...))`
  - fix: Restrict workflow modules to a safe subset when sandbox mode is enabled
  - commit: https://github.com/unashamedgeek/nuclei/commit/cf2a98b03d76327c20fb0183b7f1c849eb692c91 (2020-12-13)
- **Sandbox Escape** (high) [CWE-265]: Restricts the Tengo script imports to a safe allowlist, preventing malicious workflow logic from importing dangerous modules for code execution or network access.
  - sink: `script.SetImports(stdlib.GetModuleMap(stdlib.AllModuleNames()...))`
  - fix: Restrict allowed modules to a safe subset
  - commit: https://github.com/unashamedgeek/nuclei/commit/96049a32fa70aef0483d4180d386a57b3c2d973a (2020-12-13)
